notes: Includes 2026–27 active public and charter programs located in district 13 and the current Florida private-school survey for Miami-Dade. Five additional private campuses are independently documented on their schools’ websites, and the federally reported Miccosukee Indian School is included. Adult-only, preschool-only, public administrative codes, and six private survey addresses located outside Miami-Dade are excluded. Private survey entries with missing grades are included.

An online school or specialized program may have no routable campus. An institution with several campuses may have a single state directory record. The state does not independently verify private survey data.

County school-site geometry and county address points are matched to the physical address and ZIP. Census street-address points are approximate. Imagery shows the area around the mapped coordinate; per-image credits identify ground photographs. A listing is not a Buggy service confirmation.
